job.title: Print Lead
job.description:
Acclaimed Workforce is seeking an experienced Print Lead to join our client’s production team in Somerton.

This is a hands-on leadership position suited to someone with experience in a manufacturing, textile printing or production environment who can lead by example, maintain production standards and support the team to achieve daily targets.

About the Role

As the Print Lead, you will oversee the day-to-day operations of the print room, supporting the Print Supervisors and ensuring production goals, quality standards and workplace safety requirements are consistently met.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead and monitor Print Operators to ensure production and quality targets are achieved
  • Oversee daily print room operations and workflows
  • Check materials and equipment are correct and ready for production
  • Identify and troubleshoot common equipment issues and escalate technical problems when required
  • Coach and train team members while ensuring company policies and procedures are followed
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe production environment
  • Support continuous improvement and efficiency initiatives
  • Assist with shift handovers and task coordination
  • Complete reporting and other duties as directed by leadership
  • Work collaboratively with Print Supervisors and the wider production team
  • Step into Production Associate duties when required

About You

We're looking for someone who is proactive, reliable and confident leading a team in a fast-paced production environment.

You will ideally have:

  • Previous experience in a manufacturing, production or textile print environment
  • Previous team leadership or senior operator experience
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality
  • Good computer skills and the ability to learn production systems
  • Strong communication and time management skills
  • The ability to troubleshoot common equipment errors
  • The ability to work independently while also contributing positively to a team
  • A practical, hands-on approach and willingness to lead by example
  • The ability to follow detailed work instructions and production procedures
  • A willingness to work overtime when required

Physical Requirements

This is a hands-on production role and requires the ability to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods
  • Bend, twist, reach, push and pull
  • Perform repetitive movements
  • Handle tools, equipment and production materials
  • Lift and move materials up to 23kg (50lbs) independently, with team lifting procedures used for heavier items

What’s on Offer?

  • $39 per hour
  • Monday to Friday
  • Somerton location
  • Hands-on leadership opportunity
  • Work within a fast-paced production environment

If you have the production experience, leadership skills and hands-on attitude we're looking for, apply now to be considered for this opportunity.

job.title: Customer Experience Manager
job.description:

This is a senior opportunity to lead a customer experience and customer relations function, with real scope to shape service standards, improve systems and lift capability across a national dealer network. You’ll suit this role if you’re a confident people leader who can balance customer outcomes with commercial realities.

If you enjoy solving complex issues, using CRM insights to drive change, and working closely with senior stakeholders to improve the end-to-end customer journey, this role offers genuine influence and impact.

About the Role

You will lead the customer experience and case management function, driving service performance, continuous improvement and consistency across channels and stakeholders.
  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing customer experience team
  • Own end-to-end case management, including complex escalations
  • Set service standards, escalation pathways and resolution processes
  • Drive CRM workflow improvements, reporting and data quality
  • Partner with dealer networks and internal teams to resolve root causes
  • Build dashboards and insights to guide strategy and reduce repeat issues
Skills and Experience

To be considered for this role, you will ideally have:
  • Customer experience or customer relations leadership
  • Automotive industry exposure (dealer network, service, warranty or CRM)
  • Strong CRM capability (process, workflows, data quality and reporting)
  • Proven experience handling complex, high-pressure escalations
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills

What’s on Offer
  • High-impact leadership role with real ownership and visibility
  • Influence customer experience strategy, systems and processes
  • Work closely with senior leaders and key automotive stakeholders
  • Modern office environment based in NSW
  • Opportunity to drive measurable customer and dealer improvements
Only applicants with work rights in Australia will be eligible.

To submit your application in strict confidence, click the 'apply' button. If you require further information, please contact Joe Galea on 0415 686 282.

job.title: Warehouse Worker | Forklift Operator
job.description:
Warehouse Worker

Description

We are seeking a reliable and hardworking Warehouse Worker to join our dynamic logistics team. In this role, you will be responsible for efficiently handling all warehouse operations to ensure the smooth flow of goods and materials. The Warehouse Worker plays a critical role in maintaining the organization and inventory management of the warehouse, supporting shipping and receiving functions, and contributing to overall operational efficiency. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, are detail-oriented, and can work collaboratively with a team to meet deadlines and safety standards. The ideal candidate will have experience in handling inventory, operating warehouse equipment safely, and maintaining accurate records while adhering to all company policies and safety regulations. We value employees who show initiative, reliability, and a commitment to maintaining a clean and organized work environment. This role is essential to our supply chain operations and provides opportunities for advancement within the company. Join us and help us deliver excellent service to our customers by ensuring our warehouse functions smoothly and efficiently every day.

 

Responsibilities

  • Receive, unload, and process incoming shipments accurately and efficiently.
  • Pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment following company standards.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records and perform regular stock counts.
  • Operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts and pallet jacks safely.
  • Ensure the warehouse area is clean, organized, and compliant with safety regulations.
  • Assist with loading and unloading delivery trucks as required.
  • Report any discrepancies, damages, or safety hazards to the Manager promptly.

 

Requirements

  • Prior experience working in a warehouse or similar environment preferred.
  • Fork Lift License with the Ability to operate warehouse machinery safely and efficiently.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Physical stamina to lift heavy items and stand for extended periods.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team.
  • Basic math skills for inventory tracking and order fulfillment.
  • Commitment to following safety protocols and company policies

How to Apply 

If you’re looking to step into your next full-time role and have the right experience, we’d love to hear from you. Click "Apply Now" to submit your resume or call Kristy Gravenall on 0407 567 842 for a confidential chat and more information.
